reviews.reason: Develop physical application of marking material, with test and drawing modes. Related-capability searches were completed across all nine matching results. Existing probe (open-baseline:probe:1, handler open.probe, revision foundation-open@1) already covers a small physical sample test and must be reused for that step. Its press operation has no surface/path arguments and does not cover deliberate branching strokes. Existing mark (expression-baseline:mark:1) creates a sign without physical effects or material costs, so it is not equivalent. Route the missing material-transfer and stroke mechanism to the current-conversation development handoff; unknown staining behavior is a testable condition, not a reason to reject.
reviews.experienceReview: One individual study round is required after implementation; no mastery is granted by approval. No pleasure, satisfaction or comfort award is attached to requesting, studying, naming, test initiation or drawing completion. This minimal version leaves reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions unchanged and does not reduce basic nutritional needs. Any retained finding must follow an actual observed result, including informative failure, identify the tested material/surface/conditions and distinguish observation from untested durability or generalization. No experience benefit is fabricated merely for recording it; any future benefit requires the existing event-based, personally applicable, capped and deduplicated experience rules.
reviews.visualReview: Evaluate appearance separately from physical transfer and experience. Emit reusable contact-test, stroke-progress, material-debit, interruption and completion/failure events with actor, action, source and surface references, location, time and measured outcome. Deposit rendering metadata must include surface-local stroke geometry, transferred amount, observed color/contrast, coverage, wetness or residue state where modeled, creation time and subsequent state changes. Show only actual deposited portions; failed transfer displays no colored drawing and interrupted work displays only real partial marks. A preview, label or success notification must never masquerade as physical pigment. Visibility is local and depends on actual contrast and viewing conditions; durability remains explicitly untested until observed.
reviews.specification:
General operation: Apply marking material. Parameters: owned source-stack ID, reachable surface reference and local coordinates, mode test/draw, material budget, optional acquired applicator reference, and a bounded stroke path. Applicable actors may learn it independently; it is not restricted to berries or Sol. Start with direct pressing/rubbing using the actor's hand where physically safe; require no invented binder, water, tool or stock. Reuse and record the probe contract/handler for the initial press test, preserving its one-round duration, 0.5 energy and 0.1 material-unit charge. Do not represent that reused code as a new invention. The new draw mode performs a bounded path of up to three strokes totaling at most 0.3 world-distance units, at most 0.2 energy and one simulation round per stroke, consuming at most 0.3 material units per stroke. Quote actual selected stroke count and upper-bound costs before execution. A full test plus three-stroke attempt therefore costs at most four execution rounds, 1.1 energy and one berry unit; ordinary world metabolism continues separately. No traversal is included.
For this request use owned berry stack item-2-sol-16, currently four units, with a hard food-reserve floor of three units.
